item.title: [LU-8933] sanity test_51d: object distribution between OSTs not even
item.description:
This issue was created by maloo for Nathaniel Clark <nathaniel.l.clark@intel.com>

This issue relates to the following test suite run: https://testing.hpdd.intel.com/test_sets/15455bfe-be59-11e6-aac0-5254006e85c2.

The sub-test test_51d failed with the following error:

OST 2 has less objects vs OST 1  (228 < 278

This test passed on previous versions of this patch:
https://testing.hpdd.intel.com/sub_tests/063ca5b6-bcf8-11e6-89a8-5254006e85c2
https://testing.hpdd.intel.com/sub_tests/a549fcae-b8ba-11e6-80de-5254006e85c2
Please provide additional information about the failure here.

Info required for matching: sanity 51d
item.summary: sanity test_51d: object distribution between OSTs not even

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment: Looks like a very intermittent failure related to the test script, possibly related to the use of 2x OSS with 2x OST each allowing the OSS nodes to be unequally loaded, compared to a single OSS with 7x OSTs. Unlikely to cause problems during normal review testing.
